# infrawrench_kubernetes_efficiency_report (Resource)

A saved Kubernetes efficiency report: how much of each cluster's derived cost bought capacity that was used, requested but unused, unmeasured, idle, or cluster overhead, grouped by cluster, namespace, workload, label, node pool or cost category.

Efficiency on the `total` basis is `used / (total - unmeasured)`, so idle capacity and overhead count against it; on the `allocated` basis it is `used / (used + unused)`, what workloads reserved only. The figures are computed when the report runs, under the viewer's cost visibility scope; this resource manages the definition.

Write either `date_preset` (a rolling window) or both `date_from` and `date_to` (a fixed span).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "infrawrench_cost_report_folder" "platform" {
  name = "Platform"
}

# How efficiently each team's workloads use what they request, last 30 days,
# with idle capacity shared out across the teams that run on each cluster.
resource "infrawrench_kubernetes_efficiency_report" "by_team" {
  name        = "Kubernetes efficiency by team"
  folder_id   = infrawrench_cost_report_folder.platform.id
  date_preset = "30d"
  granularity = "week"

  group_by           = "label"
  group_by_label_key = "k8s_pod_label:team"
  idle               = "spread"
  basis              = "allocated"

  filter {
    dimension = "tag"
    tag_key   = "namespace"
    op        = "not_in"
    values    = ["kube-system"]
  }
}

# GPU and CPU waste per node pool in one cluster, for a fixed quarter.
resource "infrawrench_kubernetes_efficiency_report" "gpu_pools" {
  name       = "GPU pools Q3"
  date_from  = "2026-07-01"
  date_to    = "2026-09-30"
  group_by   = "node_pool"
  categories = ["gpu", "cpu"]

  filter {
    dimension = "account"
    op        = "in"
    values    = ["7b8c9d0e-1f2a-3b4c-5d6e-7f8a9b0c1d2e"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_by` (String) One row per value of this. One of `cluster`, `namespace`, `workload`, `label`, `node_pool`, `category`. `label` groups by `group_by_label_key`.
- `name` (String) Display name, 1–120 characters.

### Optional

- `basis` (String) Efficiency denominator: `total` or `allocated` (see the resource description). Defaults to `total`.
- `categories` (List of String) Cost categories to include, at most 7: any of `cpu`, `memory`, `gpu`, `storage`, `network`, `control_plane`, `compute`. Omitted or empty is every category.
- `date_from` (String) Inclusive start date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, with `date_to`. At most 366 days apart.
- `date_preset` (String) A rolling window resolved each time the report runs. One of `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `mtd`, `last_month`, `qtd`, `ytd`, `6m`, `12m`. Conflicts with `date_from`/`date_to`.
- `date_to` (String) Inclusive end date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, with `date_from`.
- `description` (String) Free text shown under the report title. At most 2000 characters.
- `filter` (Block List) Restricts the report, at most 20 clauses, ANDed together. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `folder_id` (String) Id of the `infrawrench_cost_report_folder` the report is filed in (efficiency reports share the cost report folder tree and inherit its sharing). Clearing it moves the report back to the top level.
- `granularity` (String) Period of the series. One of `day`, `week`, `month`; weeks start on Monday. Defaults to `day`.
- `group_by_label_key` (String) The tag key to group by when `group_by` is `label`, 1–300 characters: a pod, node or volume label (`k8s_pod_label:team`, `k8s_node_label:team`, `k8s_pvc_label:app.kubernetes.io/name`) or a normalised attribute such as `capacity_type`. Required for `label` and rejected otherwise.
- `idle` (String) `separate` keeps idle capacity and cluster overhead as their own rows; `spread` shares them across each cluster's groups, per period, in proportion to what each was allocated. Defaults to `separate`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned report id. Use it with `terraform import`.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `dimension` (String) `account` (a Kubernetes cluster's account id), `region`, or `tag` (namespace, workload, workload_kind, node_pool, capacity_type and the pod, node and volume labels).
- `op` (String) `in` to keep matching cost, `not_in` to exclude it.
- `values` (List of String) Values to match, 1–200 of them.

Optional:

- `tag_key` (String) The tag key, required when `dimension` is `tag`. 1–300 characters.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is in the URL when you open the report in the app, and in the
# --json output of `infrawrench k8s-efficiency`.
terraform import infrawrench_kubernetes_efficiency_report.example 7b8c9d0e-1f2a-3b4c-5d6e-7f8a9b0c1d2e
```
